🚨 @shantidas404’s mission and goal is to @silencetheshame the negative stigma people have around mental health. 🚨 TODAY is @silencetheshame Day, and as @shantidas404 continues fighting the good fight to help people improve and learn about their mental health, the loss of $600K in state funding heavily impacts a nonprofit like this. Listen in to hear how this organization is saving lives on @netflix. Tap in to help ➡️ silencetheshame.com or text “Silence” to 707070.

After the release segg tape, that moment forced him to reflect on his actions and allow him to live more in his purpose. Check out the full conversation on @netflix.

Allegedly, based on her contract with Lionsgate, this would be a breach of her contract. Tap into the latest with @lorenlorosa!
